wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-009 wires the pause overlay, Read-This help routing, and the menu/demo interaction into a single src/vanilla re-export facade (wirePauseAndHelpOverlays.ts) over the read-only src/ui/frontEndSequence.ts and src/ui/menus.ts, plus a frozen VANILLA_PAUSE_HELP_INVARIANTS manifest pinning the two page-timer parity rules: (1) opening the menu or Read-This help over GS_DEMOSCREEN sets menuActive which gates the D_PageTicker pagetic decrement so the title/demo page does not advance under the overlay, and (2) an in-level PAUSE (gamestate===GS_LEVEL) freezes the game tic but the front-end page timer is not running during a level so the two timers stay independent. The prior session left the facade, focused test, and progress start entry but no verified completion; on resume the focused test and the facade docstring/@example both asserted shareware/registered -> HELP1 for getInitialHelpLump, which contradicts the SHA-pinned read-only src/ui/frontEndSequence.ts (vanilla ReadDef1/ReadDef2: retail->HELP1, commercial->HELP, shareware/registered/indetermined->HELP2). Because frontEndSequence.ts is read-only and authoritative, the test expectations and the facade docstring were corrected to the true vanilla mapping (strengthened to cover all five game modes, not weakened). Pure barrel + frozen manifest; no read-only ui source modified.
